headline_design.seed_rule: replicate r, game i: BASE_SEED_B + r*1_000_000 + i; on the play iff seed % 4 == 0
headline_design.rules: fair Tainted Pact tutor + Skyturtle channel regrowth ON (008b) except *_legacy_model

secondary_design.seed_rule: replicate r, game i: BASE_SEED_B + r*1_000_000 + i; on the play iff seed % 4 == 0
secondary_design.rules: fair Tainted Pact tutor + Skyturtle channel regrowth ON (008b) except *_legacy_model

provenance.rules: 008 rules + fair Tainted Pact tutor (exile-above exposure => nondeterministic) + Colossal Skyturtle channel regrowth; *_legacy_model = exact 008 rules
provenance.dork_swap: Deathrite Shaman -> Avacyn's Pilgrim in every config except V8_frozen

definitions.stranded: no role at all at that main phase
definitions.brick: a card in the KEPT hand with no material role at any main phase T1-T4 while in hand
definitions.early_dead: a kept card with no material role at T1 or T2
definitions.priors_applied: Oracle / Consultation / Swift / Hazel castability is not development; Consultation's fair mode is 'fair_risky' (secondary); Tainted Pact castable = fair tutor (material); Spellseeker castable with a target = fair tutor; Oboro without Cradle = body only
